title: Select All skips customers already on the tier for that channel
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, named for example Quokka One, on tier A for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, named for example Quokka Two, on Default for both channels.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Type quokka in the search.
  6. Tick customer B.
  7. Click the Part Sales checkbox in the bar.
  8. Click Select All.
  9. Click the Part Sales checkbox in the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows Manage Customers.

Step 4:

  • The Add Customers tab shows.

Step 5:

  • Customers A and B are listed.

Step 6:

  • Customer B is ticked with both channels.

Step 7:

  • Customer B keeps Work Orders.

Step 8:

  • Customer A is not ticked (already on tier A for work orders).
  • Customer B stays ticked.
  • The footer adds "1 skipped: already on", tier A's name, "for Work Orders." (2 listed − 1 ticked = 1 skipped)
  • The add button is on.

Step 9:

  • Customer A can now be ticked for Part Sales.
  • Customer B is still ticked.
